stemMd: A translator retains a ceremonial title because the plot turns on its exact social status, adding a concise note. How would the two authors most likely respond?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Only the second could accept a note.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Both would reject any note as an intrusion.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Both would regard the choice as potentially justified by the expression's role in context.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Only the first could accept retaining a title.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Both would insist on replacing it with a familiar local office.

explanationMd: The first values preserving meaningful cultural distance, while the second allows retention when precise social meaning matters to action. The hypothetical meets both conditions, so their concerns need not conflict.

distractorRationale.e: That could erase the relevant social distinction.
distractorRationale.b: Both allow notes in suitable cases.
distractorRationale.d: The second permits retention when precise social meaning drives action.
distractorRationale.a: The first explicitly recommends a brief note as an option.
